mail_schema_emails:
CREATE TABLE emails (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                    from_name TEXT,
                    from_email TEXT,
                    to_email TEXT,
                    subject TEXT,
                    body TEXT,
                    body_html TEXT,
                    date TEXT,
                    has_attachment INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                    attachment_name TEXT,
                    attachment_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                    category TEXT DEFAULT 'primary',
                    subject_normalized TEXT,
                    thread_id TEXT,
                    in_reply_to INTEGER,
                    canonical_id TEXT,
                    world_id TEXT,
                    vm_id TEXT,
                    actor_id TEXT
                );
CREATE INDEX idx_emails_thread ON emails (user_email, thread_id, subject_normalized);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_emails_user_canonical ON emails (user_email, canonical_id) WHERE canonical_id IS NOT NULL;
mail_schema_sent:
CREATE TABLE sent (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
      to_name TEXT,
      to_email TEXT,
      subject TEXT,
      body TEXT,
      date TEXT,
      thread_id TEXT,
      subject_normalized TEXT,
      status TEXT DEFAULT 'sent',
      send_at TEXT,
      undo_expires_at TEXT,
      delivered_at TEXT,
      in_reply_to INTEGER,
      outbox_id TEXT
    , world_id TEXT, vm_id TEXT, actor_id TEXT);
CREATE INDEX idx_sent_status_send_at ON sent (user_email, status, send_at);
